as_told.title: Battle of Los Angeles
as_told.place_text: California coast, Santa Monica to San Diego

plain: In 1942, during what came to be called the Battle of Los Angeles, a UFO appeared and flew down the California coast, and the matter was briefed all the way up to George Marshall, a top American wartime leader. Michels tells this himself in two episodes, without naming a source; in the second he gives the route as Santa Monica to San Diego and calls Marshall Secretary of State. He tells it because, if true, it would mean the highest levels of the wartime government knew about a UFO well before the subject became famous.
